title: City Paving, Rail Lines, and Community Concerns
summary:
*   **Major Street Paving & Roadwork:** Finalized and paid for extensive paving on West Sixth Street, including special assessments for property owners, and approved bids for new sidewalks city-wide, alongside a large gravel contract for South Congress Avenue.
*   **Railroad Expansion:** Granted a significant right-of-way to a railroad company to construct a new switch track across city streets.
*   **Cemetery Bond Election Halted:** Repealed an earlier ordinance to hold a public election on issuing bonds for purchasing and improving a city cemetery.
*   **Public Welfare & Compassion:** Approved compensation for a citizen whose property (mattresses) was destroyed by health officials, and remitted a fine for a destitute youth.

Declaration.
The undersigned members of the City Council of the City of Austin, Texas, direct that this
statement be recorded in the minutes of the proceedings of the City Council of the City of
Austin.
We, the undersigned members of the City Council , here make declaration that we have
refunding bond No 345, ,in the amount of five hundred dollars ($500.00), dated the 1st day
of July 1901, and due the 1st day of July 1931, with its coupons attached all cancelled
and marked paid, as of Nov 11th 1911,and make further statement that said bond was paid by
an appropriation in the amount of four hundred, ninety four & 89¢ ($494.89 ) made by the
City Council on the 11th day of November ,1911,,said payment representing the purchase
price at ninety seven and one half cents (0.97½) on the dollar of the par of said bond,
and accrued interest from July 1st 1911, to November 13th 1911, inclusive.

Austin?Texas, 11/9/11
Hon A P Wooldridge, Austin? Texas.
Dear Sir:
Owing to the fact that I am not in justice to my business able to spare the time required
,I beg to herewith to tender my resignation as assistant Judge of election in the 5th Ward
City of Austin.

Yours truly,
Frank Doughty .
P S . Mr Robert Walling has expressed a willingness to act in the above capacity.

5.00 and costs ,amounting in the aggregate to the sum of $ 14.80,and it appearing that he
